definitions.replay:
T43 S2: open-loop replay of the RECORDED DATASET ACTIONS in the policy client's MuJoCo scene (verifier, CPU, no server).

Client  : the T42-1 client snapshot /mnt/dev/work-t42 (pi05_TO_hybrid 98e07d6 = the client that recorded the T42-1 E0/E3b
          rollouts), pi05_infer.main() run in-process with exactly the E0 arguments of outputs/verify/T42/p/run_client.sh
          (--model rby1_randomized_pick_place_16d --episode-index EP --max-steps 600 --headless --warmup-steps 1000
          --record-frames RUN --record RUN/third_person_front.mp4 --view front --trajectory-out RUN/traj.npz
          --obstacle-stop-distance 0), except: no --policy-seed (there is no model), and load_remote_policy is replaced by
          DatasetPolicy.  So the reset (reset_randomized_scene from the dataset record, actuator hold, 1000 warmup steps),
          apply_action('rby1_16d': 16-D absolute joint targets + 2 gripper openings in [0, 1] x RBY1_GRIPPER_OPEN), the
          steps per action (1 / (15 Hz * timestep)) and the recording are the client's own code.
Policy  : DatasetPolicy.infer(obs) returns the next 8 rows (OPEN_LOOP_HORIZON) of the episode's parquet 'action' column:
          control step t gets action[t] (t = 0 .. len-1); after the last frame the last action is repeated (hold) up to
          step 600.  The observation is ignored (open loop).
usage: replay_demo.py EP OUTDIR   -> OUTDIR/DEMO_ep<EP>/ (frames.jsonl, manifest.json, traj.npz, third_person_front.mp4),
       OUTDIR/DEMO_ep<EP>.replay.json (n frames, held steps, action source)
definitions.analysis:
T43 S2 analysis (verifier, CPU): demo replay vs dataset vs policy rollouts, per episode.

Runs     : DEMO = raw/replay/DEMO_ep<EP> (replay_demo.py); policy E0 / E3b = every finished run of the episode in
           outputs/verify/T42/1/runs/{E0,E3b}/noobs (.done) and outputs/verify/T39/runs/{E0,E3b} (.done).
Outcome  : T42-1 grasp_robust.robust(run_dir) = analyze_t42 (T39/T28 rule generalized: grasp = target z >= z0 + 0.050 m at a
           planning row; place = target centre inside the crate interior at the LAST planning row; success = both) + close
           command rows (applied arm gripper crossing 0.9 downward), lift_t, robust grasp (T42-1 definition B).
Geometry : T43 S measure_pick.geom_at at the first close command row (onset) and onset + 16 control rows (settled):
           tip_dz_mm / tip_dxy_mm = fingertip midpoint vs the fruit body centre, tilt_deg = approach axis vs -z,
           approach_yaw_deg_mirrored, closing_yaw_deg_mirrored_mod180, closing_elev_deg, grasp_dz/dxy (finger bodies), contacts.
           Dataset row: T43 S raw/demo_grasp.json (dataset observation.state at grasp_close_start_frame + 16; fruits at the
           recorded initial / settled poses).
Tracking : DEMO control row t qpos (commanded-at pose) vs dataset observation.state[t]: used-arm joints max |diff| (deg) over
           t <= min(len, onset + 16) and over all frames; gripper opening (|finger qpos| / 0.045) vs state col 7 / 15;
           final target xy vs the dataset's final_fruit_poses (mm).
usage: analyze_s2.py EP [EP ...]  -> raw/s2_analysis.json
definitions.action_mapping: dataset 'action' (16) = [left_arm_0..6 absolute joint targets, left_gripper opening 0..1, right_arm_0..6, right_gripper]; pi05_infer.apply_action('rby1_16d'): d.ctrl[arm actuators] = targets, d.ctrl[gripper] = clip(opening, 0, 1) * RBY1_GRIPPER_OPEN; one action per control step (15 Hz), sim steps per action = round(1 / (15 * timestep))

selection.rule: T42-1 1834/1623 (right) and 1925/1830 (left) as asked, plus T42-1 episodes covering pear/banana and E3b failures (1959 miss, 1984 grasp-only, 1957 no grasp, 1992 s2 HOLD)
